Why Tile & Grout Cleaning Is Important

April 09, 2021

Tile floors and walls can look so beautiful and impressive, like a great work of art spread out for you to walk on or touch with your hands, that is, if you have been able to properly clean them. Tile & grout cleaningcan be a real challenge to stay on top of, and although a tile floor may seem indestructible, it really does need some care. With a little bit of knowledge, you can learn all the work it takes to maintain tile.

You may not know it, but tile & grout cleaning is of the utmost importance, not only for the appearance of your floor but also to help maintain it structurally so that it can last longer. In order to show you how important tile & grout cleaningis, we have created this article with some helpful tips for maintaining your tile floor. The best way we can recommend to maintain your tile surfaces is to hire tile and grout cleaning services, to ensure that your beautiful tile stays in good shape and looks its best.

Tile Cleaning

Tile is a very strong and waterproof flooring or wall material. It is great in wet environments like the kitchen or bath and is popular for hot climates where it can feel cool on the feet. Tile cleaning is fairly easy for anyone to do, but there are some things that you need to watch out for. You can clean tile yourself, but eventually, it will need a professional touch to make it really look its best.

Be careful not to use abrasive cleaners on tiles like steel wool or even a stiff sponge. This can damage the protective coating on the tile, which will give it a dull appearance and eventually lead to water infiltrating the tile and getting into the subfloor or wall framing. This is a serious problem, not just that you will need to replace the damaged tiles, but that the integrity of the house could be in jeopardy.

A good mopping with some vinegar or bleach is the best way to clean tile floors, you can use a rag with some soapy water on tile walls. The problem with this method is that the dirty water from the mop bucket often gives an unwanted color to the grout, which is a whole different story for cleaning that we will cover in the next section.

So, it is definitely possible to accomplish tile cleaningon your own, but at some point, you will want to hire professional tile and grout cleaning services to get your tile looking as good as possible. They will use special tile cleaners that will make the tile look new again. They have knowledge and experience that you will find invaluable.

Grout Cleaning

A big mystery for a lot of folks is “how to clean grout?” Well, grout cleaningis a delicate matter that really should be left to professionals. It can take hours of scrubbing all those little lines between the tiles, and even then they may not be fully clean or they may get damaged.

Grout is the glue that holds tile together, it is made of cement, sand and water, it can also have pigment added to it which will give it a color to match the tiles. Grout stains pretty easily, and trying to rub it too hard to clean it can actually wear it away.

If grout wears away too much from bad cleaning techniques, water can get behind the tiles and it is only a matter of time before tiles start breaking or the subfloor and wall become compromised.

If you want to try grout cleaning yourself, you can sprinkle baking soda on all the grout, then pour on some hydrogen peroxide and let it sit for 10 or 20 minutes, then you can scrub all the grout with a toothbrush. This is a really time-consuming process and could make your hands feel pretty sore. You also need to be careful to scrub gently, as too rough could damage the grout.

The real best way of grout cleaningis to hire a professional cleaner. They will have the special tools and grout cleanersthat will make the grout look as beautiful as possible without damaging it. Grout cleaning servicesare more affordable than you think, and will save your hands a day of soreness.

Without regular professional cleaning, the grout in between tiles will start to look black and dirty. Not only does this look bad, but it can also harbor bacteria that could give off offensive odors or even make you sick. That is why hiring professional grout cleaning servicesis so important.

Tile & Grout Longevity

When a tile and grout surface is not well maintained and properly cleaned, it can wear out way faster than it should. Improper cleaning can literally take years off the life of a tile and grout surface, while with proper care and cleaning, a tile surface could outlive you. So it is really important that you care for your tile.

Putting in a new tile floor or wall can be a long and expensive task. You really want to protect them and make them last as long as possible. The best way to do this is to hire professional tile and grout cleaning services.

Tile & grout cleaningis a long and difficult process, hiring a professional will save you a lot of time that could be spent in so many better ways. Professional cleaning is really not that expensive, especially if you think of all the other things you could be doing instead of spending hours scrubbing and mopping.
Tile & grout cleaningis a very delicate process, that you could be doing wrong and doing a lot of harm to your tile floor or walls. It is really smart just to have a professional come and do the job the right way. They have all the tools and the special cleaners that get the job done much better than you will be able to.
